title: One flat.
html_source: Key of F Major. Apparently a different key than the one Dedalus had just played in.

anchor.prefix:
Well... 

 Mr Dedalus laid his pipe to rest beside the tuningfork and, sitting, touched the obedient keys. 

1922#260

 — No, Simon, Father Cowley turned. Play it in the original.
anchor.suffix:
1961#271

 The keys, obedient, rose higher, told, faltered, confessed, confused. 

 Up stage strode Father Cowley. 

 — Here, Simon, I'll accompany you, he said. Get up. 

 By G
